changes.description: Independent Project Services: Added support for creating service documents without linking them to an invoice.
Standalone Customer Information: Added customer name, project name, phone number, and address fields for independent service projects.
Service Phone Validation: Added 10-digit phone number validation for standalone customer information.
Service Document Details: Standalone customer information is now retained when editing and displayed in service previews, details, and recent service listings.
Standalone Preview Contact Details: Fixed standalone customer phone numbers and addresses not appearing in service document previews and details.
